assessment: speaker-scout SPEC to beads tickets. First pass: 12 tickets, valid acyclic graph, correct phase order, but user review found half too broad and early edges over-serialized (only one ready ticket). Root causes worth keeping: (1) I attached schema-only dependencies (ss-80g) to tickets that could define types locally and reconcile at review - contract tickets should rarely block pure-logic or shell tickets; (2) I bundled contract+implementation, core+lifecycle, and implementation+QA into single tickets - splitting each roughly doubled the ready frontier (1 to 4); (3) bd lint flagged missing acceptance sections - bd has a dedicated --acceptance field, use it from the start. Remediation created 7 split tickets, rewired 10 edges, rewrote all descriptions with What/Exclusions/Verification plus acceptance checklists; final graph: 19 issues, 4 ready, no cycles, lint clean. Tooling traps hit: zsh does not word-split ${var:+--flag "$var"} so optional flags must use explicit branches; bd init needs GIT_DIR workaround when .git creation is host-blocked; silenced stderr masked the real flag error for a whole batch.
